descriptions.room_manage_notice: Publish, correct, republish, and clear room notices
descriptions.room_list: See rooms in the directory. A user can be allowed to see a room (e.g. to request access) without being allowed to join it.
descriptions.room_manage: Edit a room's settings and permissions, and delete rooms
descriptions.room_remove_member: Remove members from rooms and optionally suspend rejoining
descriptions.message_read: Read all messages in rooms. Removing this permission still allows limited access if message.read-interactions is granted separately.
descriptions.message_read_interactions: Read complete threads that you authored or where another user directly mentioned you
descriptions.message_post: Post messages and thread replies, and start DMs
descriptions.message_post_interactions: Reply in threads you started, where you were directly mentioned, or where you received a DM
descriptions.message_echo: When posting in a thread, also surface the message in the main channel
descriptions.message_manage: Edit and delete other users' messages
descriptions.message_react: Add and remove reactions on messages
descriptions.role_manage: Create, edit, delete, and reorder roles and their permission grants
descriptions.role_assign: Assign and revoke roles for users
descriptions.admin_view_users: View the users page in admin
descriptions.admin_view_audit: View the audit log in admin
descriptions.user_manage_invites: Create and manage codes. Each code admits one new account.
descriptions.user_invite: Generate invitation codes without admin access.
descriptions.user_manage_accounts: Create users, edit account identity, reset passwords, attach verified emails, and clear login cooldowns
descriptions.bot_manage: View and manage every bot account
descriptions.call_screenshare: Share a screen or application, including captured audio
descriptions.room_invite: Invite server members to rooms that you have joined
